named_gap: Reduce the adopted model's nominal Dart contact miss below 1 mm without weakening the other task limits.
policy: One learner remains the product. Attribute model error versus consumer objective/optimization before changing either. No platform branch, simulator information supplied to the learner, target-specific model correction, or consumer model option.

stage_1.purpose: Attribute the existing 6.19 mm miss from already recorded predictions and executed commands.
stage_1.data: All 40 selected plans, their 40 causal initial histories, the 120 executed commands/states and unchanged target/contact scorer from the authenticated baseline.
measurements: First-contact score for each learned selected plan truncated to its remaining deadline; report no crossing explicitly.
Contact-point and center-of-mass position, velocity and body-rate errors against actually executed truth at every 10, 20 and 30 ms prefix for all 40 plans.
Deadline terminal contact-point lateral error versus first-crossing error, with final three origins reported individually.
Last replan's predicted versus actual first-contact position, time, axis and speeds. Earlier full-plan contact scores are predictions, never compared as if their unexecuted commands were truth.
Numerical contact audit using the existing independent scorer; no task-success tolerance adjustment.
stage_1.acceptance: All saved origins and eligible prefixes accounted for; source/data identities bound before evaluation; no fit, optimizer solve or new native step. This is attribution, not a new success claim.
stage_1.decision: Inspect whether the final predicted miss and deadline objective tradeoff already explain the miss or whether executed-prefix model residuals dominate. Choose one intervention afterward, committing a prospective stage-2 contract before implementing or running it.

ultimate_success.contact: first front-to-back crossing on the original native plant
ultimate_success.finite: All selected predictions, actual solver callbacks and native states; record convergence and runtime separately.
ultimate_success.scope: A nominal pass is a nominal pass. Any neighborhood reliability claim requires a frozen roster and all conditions reported; tuning cases are not held-out validation.

reporting: Preserve every started attempt and failure. Keep immutable baseline; use one new iteration evidence directory. No retries hidden behind overwritten output. Retain only the current useful benchmark tooling and compact results.
